📦 **meadow-med1214 `f9145568`** — feat(goods): Mediterranean olive and silk chains with new pixel icons

Add olives, olive oil, raw silk and silk cloth; enable rice, beans and citrus. Add orchard, sericulture and oil-mill buildings, silk weaving and olive-oil soap, with suitability rules and tree switching protection. Extend shared town models and connect the orchard tree from Blockside78a238d.

Four transparent128px icons and32px light/dark checks, archived originals and prompts, native trade UI screenshots, and gallery5c750da. Cost placeholders follow the existing1.2 multiplier. Bean stew is now enabled on ships with conserved calories and actual bean consumption. Unknown silk does not reduce a town's prosperity before supply is introduced.

Validation:92 production/consumption/ecology/model checks; resource and dish tables, building/model generation checks, negative missing-art control, ship menu/luxury scenarios, trade cost checks, and140 legacy tree mesh comparisons. Existing recipes_check --days2 retains the same two baseline failures, documented in evidence.

Tim removed the old-town byte-identical two-year requirement; TASK-1214 acceptance updated accordingly. Regional recipes and dish artwork are separately tracked in TASK-1235 and TASK-1236.

Refs TASK-1214
Refs TASK-1233

👥 參與者：@meadow
